title: FantacalcioManualReviewItem
description: One item in the design-only manual review queue (Batch 0E). A data contract, NOT an implementation: no UI, no DB, no real data. Created when a validation or identity step needs a human decision before proceeding. Blocking items keep data_promoted OFF.

origin_ref.description: validation_id or identity_candidate_id that raised this item.

candidates.description: Possible matches to choose from (empty when none).

ref.description: Reference to a candidate identity/record. No secrets.

blocking.description: True when this item blocks promotion until resolved.

resolution.description: Null while open. Set when resolved/rejected.

decided_by.description: Symbolic actor (e.g. 'owner'). Not a real account/email/secret.

identity_signals.description: Optional generic FASE 3 identity-comparison evidence for a future human reviewer (packages/identity-policy). Only present for identity-origin review items raised by one of the three review_* outcomes below — never carries a canonical_player_id/canonical_team_id or any real player/team reference.

outcome.description: Restricted to the three identity-candidate outcomes that ever raise a review item (see packages/identity-policy/src/candidateKeyPolicy.ts IDENTITY_CANDIDATE_OUTCOMES).
